target.query: Return one synthetic terminal-success result containing this ticket and owner context; read or mutate no production data.

trigger.description: Once per minute during the disposable proof

conditions.success: The same owner receives one synthetic terminal-success result.
conditions.finding: The persisted automation differs from this spec or a new task is created.
conditions.timeout: No same-owner result arrives before the proof window ends.
conditions.cancel: The owner deletes the disposable automation or any safety invariant fails.

resultDestination.fallbackHandoff: one concise message to coordinator task 01900000-0000-7000-8000-000000000002
